paper_metadata.title: Structure and mechanical properties of the annealed TZAV-30 alloy

evidence.quote: Recently, new Ti–Zr–Al–V (TZAV) series alloys [12–15] with ultra-high strength were developed, among which the strength of Ti–30Zr–5Al–3V (wt.%, TZAV-30) alloy is over 1600 MPa.
